Priya (oncall): paging — seeing large tail latency on streaming inference since 03:12 UTC. p95 ~ 700ms -> normal, p99 jumping to 2.2s and a bunch of streaming stalls reported by clients. SLO alarm fired (inference.streaming.latency.p99 > 1.5s).
incident-bot: ALERT triggered: inference.streaming.latency.p99 = 2.2s (3:14:08 UTC). Pager sent to @pri.
Priya (oncall): quick triage: spike started around 03:12, coincident with a flurry of 503s from config-service in control plane logs. I can see config-fetch retries per request increasing.
Robin (sre): I'm seeing auth-db CPU and db-conn queue growth ~03:10 -> 03:15. auth-db p99 read latency ~480ms, some 5xxs. Could be causing blocking on token validation path.
Mateo (infra): deployed a small config-service restart at 03:11 for a health probe flapping — marking the window. rolling restarts may have caused connection storm to auth-db.
Emily (prod): customer tickets starting to come in: streaming sessions stalled, some timeouts at client level. impact: real-time chat features degraded for ~8% of sessions in NA.
Alex P.: Priya — want me to take lead? handing oncall to Alex in 15. Priya — tl;dr of steps already taken?
Priya (oncall): handoff to Alex in 2m. Actions so far: 1) triaged to control-plane config & auth dependency, 2) rate limiter bumped to allow more burst for enterprise customers (temporary), 3) started higher logging for config-fetch path.
Alex P.: taking over. I'll coordinate mitigations. First step: throttle non-critical config fetches and enable local cache fallback for streaming path to avoid sync-config calls during generation.
Robin (sre): digging into traces — most slow requests show repeated config-fetch RPCs in the critical path (sync on start-of-stream). stack: inference-proxy -> controlplane/config -> auth -> token-store -> db. token-store 503 rate spiked.
Mateo (infra): token-store pods show increased restart count from liveness probe failures after the config-service restarts. Node-level network flaps on one AZ around 03:09-03:13. NV stats attached in logs.
Priya (oncall): mitigation proposal: 1) flip feature flag "ff/runtime-sync-config" to async / fallback to cached config; 2) temporarily relax per-client rate-limit for streaming to avoid client-facing requeues; 3) scale token-store replicas by +2 immediately. Agree? :thinking_face:
Emily (prod): do those changes risk correctness? we need to avoid misrouting or serving wrong model versions. If we use cached config, ensure it is within last 5m.
Alex P.: agree with Emily — set cached config TTL to 5m and log deviations. I'll push the flag change to canary then global if green.
Robin (sre): concurrently rolling up token-store replicas now. Running `kubectl scale deploy/token-store --replicas=6 -n controlplane`. Also increasing DB connection pool for token-store to reduce queuing.
incident-bot: ACTION: oncall change — Alex P. is now oncall (03:17 UTC).
Alex P.: kicked off flag change to async path for the canary subset (10% of traffic). Monitoring p99 on that slice. Patch posted: `service/config-client: support cached-fallback-ttl=300s`.
Priya (oncall): leaving notes and switching to standby. if things escalate, ping my mobile.
Mateo (infra): DB ops — auth-db read replicas healthy; primary shows CPU drop after connection pool increase. token-store pod restarts reduced after scaling.
Robin (sre): initial canary looks promising: canary p99 down to 900ms in 2 minutes (was 2.1s). Global p99 still elevated for now.
Alex P.: rolling the flag to 50% then 100%. Rolling now.
Emily (prod): notifying customers who reported issues that we're applying fallback to cached config and scaling token-store. ETA for full mitigation 10-15m, will update.
Robin (sre): after global rollout, system p99 down to 650ms and streaming stall rate dropped by ~70%. Backpressure on auth-db subsided.
Alex P.: follow-up tasks: 1) postmortem owner? 2) root cause hypothesis: config-service restart led to token-store connection storms and auth-db contention, amplified by sync-config calls blocking streaming start-of-session. 3) short-term: keep cached TTL=5m and add jitter to config fetch.
Priya (oncall): I've logged incident in PagerDuty with severity P2 and linked traces. handing complete.
Emily (prod): please also add customers impacted list and timeline for 03:09-03:28. I'll prepare customer comms draft.
Robin (sre): I'll keep an eye on auth-db for 1h and schedule follow-up runbook update to avoid sync-on-start behaviour in streaming path.
Alex P.: closing actions: ticket created INF-4593 (postmortem + timeline), action items assigned: Mateo -> infra autoscaling + node analysis; Robin -> runbook + DB tuning; Priya -> customer comms; Alex -> ensure feature flag change is safe and remove once token-store stable.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: issue mitigated, SLOs recovering. p99 now 0.63s. Incident marked as "mitigated - monitoring" (03:28 UTC).
Emily (prod): thanks all. :tada: good handoff and quick mitigation.
